```{r}
############################################################
## 0. 유틸리티: ROC-AUC
############################################################

roc_auc <- function(score, label) {
  # label: 1 = outlier, 0 = inlier
  stopifnot(length(score) == length(label))
  pos <- (label == 1)
  P <- sum(pos)
  N <- sum(!pos)
  if (P == 0 || N == 0) return(NA_real_)
  
  r <- rank(score, ties.method = "average")
  sum_r_pos <- sum(r[pos])
  auc <- (sum_r_pos - P * (P + 1) / 2) / (P * N)
  auc
}

############################################################
## 1. 데이터 생성: Gaussian + mean-shift outlier
############################################################

make_ar1_cov <- function(d, rho = 0.5) {
  idx <- 1:d
  outer(idx, idx, function(i, j) rho ^ abs(i - j))
}

generate_data <- function(n = 600,
                          d = 16,
                          contamination = 0.1,
                          mu_shift = 6,
                          rho = 0.5,
                          seed = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  
  n_out <- round(n * contamination)
  n_in  <- n - n_out
  
  Sigma <- make_ar1_cov(d, rho)
  L <- chol(Sigma)
  
  # inlier: N(0, Sigma)
  X_in <- matrix(rnorm(n_in * d), n_in, d) %*% L
  
  # outlier: mean-shift 방향 (1,...,1)/sqrt(d)
  dir_vec <- rep(1, d)
  dir_vec <- dir_vec / sqrt(sum(dir_vec^2))
  mu_vec <- mu_shift * dir_vec
  
  X_out <- matrix(rnorm(n_out * d), n_out, d) + 
    matrix(rep(mu_vec, each = n_out), n_out, d, byrow = FALSE)
  
  X <- rbind(X_in, X_out)
  y <- c(rep(0, n_in), rep(1, n_out))  # 0=inlier, 1=outlier
  
  idx <- sample(1:nrow(X))
  X <- X[idx, , drop = FALSE]
  y <- y[idx]
  
  list(X = X, y = y)
}

############################################################
## 2. RBF 커널
############################################################

rbf_kernel <- function(X, sigma = NULL) {
  n <- nrow(X)
  D2 <- as.matrix(dist(X))^2
  
  if (is.null(sigma)) {
    med <- median(D2[upper.tri(D2)])
    sigma <- sqrt(med / 2)
  }
  
  K <- exp(-D2 / (2 * sigma^2))
  list(K = K, sigma = sigma)
}

############################################################
## 3. weighted KPCA: weighted centering + eigen
############################################################

weighted_kpca_from_weights <- function(K, w, r) {
  n <- nrow(K)
  stopifnot(length(w) == n)
  w <- as.numeric(w)
  if (any(w < 0)) stop("weights must be nonnegative")
  s_w <- sum(w)
  if (s_w <= 0) stop("sum of weights must be > 0")
  w <- w / s_w  # normalize to sum 1
  
  # ---- weighted centering ----
  Kw  <- K %*% w                     # length n
  wK  <- as.numeric(t(w) %*% K)      # length n
  kwk <- as.numeric(t(w) %*% Kw)     # scalar
  
  # Kc_ij = K_ij - (w^T K)_j - (K w)_i + w^T K w
  Kc <- K -
    matrix(wK, nrow = n, ncol = n, byrow = TRUE) -
    matrix(Kw, nrow = n, ncol = n, byrow = FALSE) +
    kwk
  
  # ---- eigen of G = sqrt(W) Kc sqrt(W) ----
  sqrtw <- sqrt(w)
  D <- diag(sqrtw)
  G <- D %*% Kc %*% D
  
  eig <- eigen(G, symmetric = TRUE)
  lam_all <- eig$values
  vec_all <- eig$vectors
  
  pos <- which(lam_all > 1e-10)
  if (length(pos) == 0) stop("No positive eigenvalues in weighted KPCA.")
  
  if (length(pos) < r) {
    warning(sprintf("Only %d positive eigenvalues; reducing r.", length(pos)))
    r_use <- length(pos)
  } else {
    r_use <- r
  }
  
  lam <- lam_all[pos[1:r_use]]
  V   <- vec_all[, pos[1:r_use], drop = FALSE]
  
  # alpha_{jm} = sqrt(w_j) * v_{jm} / sqrt(lambda_m)
  alpha <- matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = r_use)
  for (m in 1:r_use) {
    alpha[, m] <- sqrtw * V[, m] / sqrt(lam[m])
  }
  
  # scores T = Kc %*% alpha
  T <- Kc %*% alpha
  diag_kc <- diag(Kc)
  
  E2 <- pmax(diag_kc - rowSums(T^2), 0)
  E  <- sqrt(E2)
  
  list(
    w = w,
    Kc = Kc,
    lam = lam,
    alpha = alpha,
    E = E
  )
}

############################################################
## 4. OOS 재구성 오차 (train에서 학습된 weighted KPCA → val)
############################################################

reconstruction_error_oos_weighted <- function(K_full,
                                              train_idx,
                                              val_idx,
                                              w_train,
                                              lam,
                                              alpha) {
  K_train <- K_full[train_idx, train_idx, drop = FALSE]
  n_train <- length(train_idx)
  r_use   <- length(lam)
  
  # train 기준 weighted centering 정보
  Kw  <- K_train %*% w_train
  wK  <- as.numeric(t(w_train) %*% K_train)
  kwk <- as.numeric(t(w_train) %*% Kw)
  
  E_val <- numeric(length(val_idx))
  
  for (ii in seq_along(val_idx)) {
    i <- val_idx[ii]
    
    k_i_train <- K_full[i, train_idx]
    mean_k_i  <- sum(k_i_train * w_train)
    
    # k_c(i,j)
    k_c_i_train <- k_i_train - wK - mean_k_i + kwk
    
    # scores
    t_vec <- as.numeric(k_c_i_train %*% alpha)  # length r_use
    
    # k_c(i,i)
    k_c_ii <- K_full[i, i] - 2 * mean_k_i + kwk
    
    E2 <- max(k_c_ii - sum(t_vec^2), 0)
    E_val[ii] <- sqrt(E2)
  }
  
  E_val
}

############################################################
## 5. (p,q,lambda) 일반 shift 업데이트 (1D 최소화)
############################################################

update_shift_scalar <- function(Ei, p, q, lambda,
                                upper_factor = 5) {
  if (Ei <= 0) return(0)
  
  f_obj <- function(s) {
    (1 / p) * abs(Ei - s)^p + lambda * (1 / q) * abs(s)^q
  }
  
  U <- Ei + upper_factor * (Ei + 1)
  
  opt <- tryCatch(
    optimize(f_obj, interval = c(0, U), tol = 1e-6),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(opt)) {
    return(max(Ei - 1, 0))
  } else {
    return(max(opt$minimum, 0))
  }
}

update_shift_all <- function(E, p, q, lambda) {
  sapply(E, update_shift_scalar, p = p, q = q, lambda = lambda)
}

############################################################
## 6. IRLS 가중치 업데이트 (LS-KPCA용)
##    w_i ∝ |E_i - s_i|^{p-2}
############################################################

update_irls_weights <- function(E, s, p,
                                eps = 1e-6,
                                cap = 1e6) {
  r <- E - s
  r_abs <- pmax(abs(r), eps)
  exponent <- p - 2
  
  w_raw <- r_abs^exponent
  w_raw[!is.finite(w_raw)] <- cap
  w_raw <- pmin(w_raw, cap)
  
  s_w <- sum(w_raw)
  if (s_w <= 0) {
    w <- rep(1 / length(E), length(E))
  } else {
    w <- w_raw / s_w
  }
  w
}

############################################################
## 7. LS-KPCA (L_p-L_q) + IRLS weighted KPCA
############################################################

ls_kpca_irls_weighted <- function(K,
                                  r = 2,
                                  p = 2,
                                  q = 1,
                                  lambda = 1,
                                  max_iter = 20,
                                  tol = 1e-4,
                                  verbose = TRUE) {
  n <- nrow(K)
  
  # 초기: uniform
  w <- rep(1 / n, n)
  
  model <- weighted_kpca_from_weights(K, w, r)
  E <- model$E
  s <- update_shift_all(E, p = p, q = q, lambda = lambda)
  
  loss_term <- (1 / p) * abs(E - s)^p + lambda * (1 / q) * abs(s)^q
  obj_old <- sum(loss_term)
  if (verbose) cat(sprintf("Init LS-KPCA: obj = %.6f\n", obj_old))
  
  for (it in 1:max_iter) {
    # w-step
    w <- update_irls_weights(E, s, p = p)
    
    # U-step
    model <- weighted_kpca_from_weights(K, w, r)
    E <- model$E
    
    # s-step
    s <- update_shift_all(E, p = p, q = q, lambda = lambda)
    
    loss_term <- (1 / p) * abs(E - s)^p + lambda * (1 / q) * abs(s)^q
    obj_new <- sum(loss_term)
    
    if (verbose) {
      cat(sprintf("LS Iter %2d: obj = %.6f, Δ = %.3e\n",
                  it, obj_new, obj_new - obj_old))
    }
    
    if (abs(obj_new - obj_old) < tol * (abs(obj_old) + 1e-8)) {
      if (verbose) cat("LS-KPCA converged.\n")
      obj_old <- obj_new
      break
    }
    
    obj_old <- obj_new
  }
  
  list(
    w = model$w,
    Kc = model$Kc,
    lam = model$lam,
    alpha = model$alpha,
    E = E,
    s = s,
    obj = obj_old
  )
}

############################################################
## 8. LS-KPCA: OOS에서 outlier score (s*)
############################################################

outlier_score_oos_ls <- function(K_full,
                                 train_idx,
                                 val_idx,
                                 w_train,
                                 lam,
                                 alpha,
                                 p,
                                 q,
                                 lambda) {
  E_val <- reconstruction_error_oos_weighted(
    K_full   = K_full,
    train_idx = train_idx,
    val_idx   = val_idx,
    w_train   = w_train,
    lam       = lam,
    alpha     = alpha
  )
  s_val <- update_shift_all(E_val, p = p, q = q, lambda = lambda)
  list(E = E_val, s = s_val)
}

############################################################
## 9. Lp-KPCA (shift 없는 robust KPCA) + IRLS
##    -> FCPCA/L_{2,p} 스타일 벤치마크
############################################################

lp_kpca_irls_weighted <- function(K,
                                  r = 2,
                                  p = 1.0,
                                  max_iter = 20,
                                  tol = 1e-4,
                                  verbose = TRUE) {
  n <- nrow(K)
  w <- rep(1 / n, n)
  
  model <- weighted_kpca_from_weights(K, w, r)
  E <- model$E
  obj_old <- sum((1 / p) * abs(E)^p)
  if (verbose) cat(sprintf("Init Lp-KPCA: obj = %.6f\n", obj_old))
  
  for (it in 1:max_iter) {
    # IRLS weight (s=0)
    w <- update_irls_weights(E, s = rep(0, n), p = p)
    
    model <- weighted_kpca_from_weights(K, w, r)
    E <- model$E
    obj_new <- sum((1 / p) * abs(E)^p)
    
    if (verbose) {
      cat(sprintf("Lp Iter %2d: obj = %.6f, Δ = %.3e\n",
                  it, obj_new, obj_new - obj_old))
    }
    
    if (abs(obj_new - obj_old) < tol * (abs(obj_old) + 1e-8)) {
      if (verbose) cat("Lp-KPCA converged.\n")
      obj_old <- obj_new
      break
    }
    
    obj_old <- obj_new
  }
  
  list(
    w = model$w,
    Kc = model$Kc,
    lam = model$lam,
    alpha = model$alpha,
    E = E,
    obj = obj_old
  )
}

############################################################
## 10. CV: Lp-KPCA (p-grid) with precomputed K_full, folds
############################################################

cv_lp_kpca_irls_K <- function(K_full, y, folds,
                              p_grid   = c(2.0, 1.5, 1.0),
                              r        = 2,
                              max_iter = 20,
                              tol      = 1e-4,
                              verbose  = TRUE) {
  nfold <- max(folds)
  results <- data.frame()
  best_score <- -Inf
  best_cfg <- NULL
  
  for (p in p_grid) {
    auc_vec <- numeric(nfold)
    
    if (verbose) {
      cat("========================================\n")
      cat(sprintf("CV Lp-KPCA: p = %.2f\n", p))
    }
    
    for (k in 1:nfold) {
      train_idx <- which(folds != k)
      val_idx   <- which(folds == k)
      K_train <- K_full[train_idx, train_idx, drop = FALSE]
      
      fit <- lp_kpca_irls_weighted(
        K        = K_train,
        r        = r,
        p        = p,
        max_iter = max_iter,
        tol      = tol,
        verbose  = FALSE
      )
      
      E_val <- reconstruction_error_oos_weighted(
        K_full   = K_full,
        train_idx = train_idx,
        val_idx   = val_idx,
        w_train   = fit$w,
        lam       = fit$lam,
        alpha     = fit$alpha
      )
      
      auc_vec[k] <- roc_auc(E_val, y[val_idx])
    }
    
    mean_auc <- mean(auc_vec, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    if (verbose) {
      cat(sprintf("  -> mean CV AUC (Lp-KPCA) = %.4f\n", mean_auc))
    }
    
    results <- rbind(
      results,
      data.frame(
        p       = p,
        mean_auc = mean_auc
      )
    )
    
    if (mean_auc > best_score) {
      best_score <- mean_auc
      best_cfg <- list(p = p)
    }
  }
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("========================================\n")
    cat("Best Lp-KPCA hyperparameter (by CV AUC):\n")
    print(best_cfg)
    cat(sprintf("Best mean AUC = %.4f\n", best_score))
  }
  
  # 전체 데이터에 대해 최적 p로 다시 학습
  fit_best <- lp_kpca_irls_weighted(
    K        = K_full,
    r        = r,
    p        = best_cfg$p,
    max_iter = max_iter,
    tol      = tol,
    verbose  = TRUE
  )
  
  list(
    results    = results,
    best       = best_cfg,
    best_score = best_score,
    fit        = fit_best
  )
}

############################################################
## 11. CV: LS-KPCA (p,q,lambda grid) with precomputed K_full, folds
############################################################

cv_ls_kpca_irls_K <- function(K_full, y, folds,
                              p_grid      = c(2.0, 1.5, 1.0),
                              q_grid      = c(1.0, 0.5),
                              lambda_grid = c(0.5, 1.0, 2.0),
                              r           = 2,
                              max_iter    = 20,
                              tol         = 1e-4,
                              verbose     = TRUE) {
  nfold <- max(folds)
  results <- data.frame()
  best_score <- -Inf
  best_cfg <- NULL
  
  for (p in p_grid) {
    for (q in q_grid) {
      for (lam in lambda_grid) {
        auc_vec <- numeric(nfold)
        
        if (verbose) {
          cat("========================================\n")
          cat(sprintf("CV LS-KPCA: (p,q,lambda) = (%.2f, %.2f, %.3f)\n",
                      p, q, lam))
        }
        
        for (k in 1:nfold) {
          train_idx <- which(folds != k)
          val_idx   <- which(folds == k)
          K_train <- K_full[train_idx, train_idx, drop = FALSE]
          
          fit <- ls_kpca_irls_weighted(
            K        = K_train,
            r        = r,
            p        = p,
            q        = q,
            lambda   = lam,
            max_iter = max_iter,
            tol      = tol,
            verbose  = FALSE
          )
          
          scores_val <- outlier_score_oos_ls(
            K_full   = K_full,
            train_idx = train_idx,
            val_idx   = val_idx,
            w_train   = fit$w,
            lam       = fit$lam,
            alpha     = fit$alpha,
            p         = p,
            q         = q,
            lambda    = lam
          )
          
          auc_vec[k] <- roc_auc(scores_val$s, y[val_idx])
        }
        
        mean_auc <- mean(auc_vec, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (verbose) {
          cat(sprintf("  -> mean CV AUC (LS-KPCA) = %.4f\n", mean_auc))
        }
        
        results <- rbind(
          results,
          data.frame(
            p        = p,
            q        = q,
            lambda   = lam,
            mean_auc = mean_auc
          )
        )
        
        if (mean_auc > best_score) {
          best_score <- mean_auc
          best_cfg <- list(p = p, q = q, lambda = lam)
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("========================================\n")
    cat("Best LS-KPCA hyperparameters (by CV AUC):\n")
    print(best_cfg)
    cat(sprintf("Best mean AUC = %.4f\n", best_score))
  }
  
  # 전체 데이터에 대해 최적 (p,q,lambda)로 다시 학습
  fit_best <- ls_kpca_irls_weighted(
    K        = K_full,
    r        = r,
    p        = best_cfg$p,
    q        = best_cfg$q,
    lambda   = best_cfg$lambda,
    max_iter = max_iter,
    tol      = tol,
    verbose  = TRUE
  )
  
  list(
    results    = results,
    best       = best_cfg,
    best_score = best_score,
    fit        = fit_best
  )
}

############################################################
## 12. Benchmark 전체 통합:
##     - Baseline KPCA
##     - Lp-KPCA (IRLS, p CV)
##     - LS-KPCA (IRLS, p,q,lambda CV)
############################################################

run_benchmarks_for_dim <- function(d,
                                   n = 600,
                                   contamination = 0.1,
                                   mu_shift = 6,
                                   rho = 0.5,
                                   r = 2,
                                   nfold = 3,
                                   seed_data  = 123,
                                   seed_kernel = 1,
                                   seed_cv    = 2025,
                                   p_grid_lp  = c(2.0, 1.5, 1.0),
                                   p_grid_ls  = c(2.0, 1.5, 1.0),
                                   q_grid_ls  = c(1.0, 0.5),
                                   lambda_grid_ls = c(0.5, 1.0, 2.0),
                                   max_iter = 20,
                                   tol = 1e-4,
                                   verbose = TRUE) {
  cat("####################################################\n")
  cat(sprintf("Dimension d = %d\n", d))
  
  # 1) 데이터 생성
  dat <- generate_data(
    n = n, d = d,
    contamination = contamination,
    mu_shift = mu_shift,
    rho = rho,
    seed = seed_data
  )
  X <- dat$X
  y <- dat$y
  
  # 2) 커널
  set.seed(seed_kernel)
  ker <- rbf_kernel(X)
  K_full <- ker$K
  sigma  <- ker$sigma
  cat(sprintf("RBF sigma (median heuristic) = %.3f\n", sigma))
  
  n_obs <- nrow(X)
  
  # 3) CV folds
  set.seed(seed_cv)
  folds <- sample(rep(1:nfold, length.out = n_obs))
  
  # 4) Baseline KPCA (uniform weights)
  w_unif <- rep(1 / n_obs, n_obs)
  base_model <- weighted_kpca_from_weights(K_full, w_unif, r = r)
  E_base <- base_model$E
  auc_base <- roc_auc(E_base, y)
  cat(sprintf("Baseline KPCA AUC (E_i as score) = %.3f\n", auc_base))
  
  # 5) Lp-KPCA (IRLS, p CV)
  lp_cv <- cv_lp_kpca_irls_K(
    K_full  = K_full,
    y       = y,
    folds   = folds,
    p_grid  = p_grid_lp,
    r       = r,
    max_iter = max_iter,
    tol      = tol,
    verbose  = verbose
  )
  fit_lp <- lp_cv$fit
  auc_lp <- roc_auc(fit_lp$E, y)
  cat(sprintf("Lp-KPCA (best p=%.2f) AUC = %.3f\n",
              lp_cv$best$p, auc_lp))
  
  # 6) LS-KPCA (IRLS, p,q,lambda CV)
  ls_cv <- cv_ls_kpca_irls_K(
    K_full       = K_full,
    y            = y,
    folds        = folds,
    p_grid       = p_grid_ls,
    q_grid       = q_grid_ls,
    lambda_grid  = lambda_grid_ls,
    r            = r,
    max_iter     = max_iter,
    tol          = tol,
    verbose      = verbose
  )
  fit_ls <- ls_cv$fit
  auc_ls <- roc_auc(fit_ls$s, y)
  cat(sprintf("LS-KPCA (best p=%.2f, q=%.2f, lambda=%.3f) AUC = %.3f\n",
              ls_cv$best$p, ls_cv$best$q, ls_cv$best$lambda, auc_ls))
  
  # 결과 요약 data.frame
  summary_df <- data.frame(
    method = c("KPCA", "Lp-KPCA", "LS-KPCA"),
    d      = d,
    auc    = c(auc_base, auc_lp, auc_ls)
  )
  
  list(
    summary   = summary_df,
    base_auc  = auc_base,
    lp_cv     = lp_cv,
    ls_cv     = ls_cv,
    K_full    = K_full,
    X         = X,
    y         = y
  )
}

############################################################
## 13. 예시 실행: d ∈ {2, 4, 16, 256}
############################################################

dims <- c(2, 4, 16)

benchmark_results <- lapply(dims, function(dd) {
  run_benchmarks_for_dim(
    d = dd,
    n = 600,
    contamination = 0.1,
    r = 2,
    nfold = 3,
    # 그리드 크면 오래 걸리니까 적당히 조절
    p_grid_lp  = c(2.0, 1.5, 1.0, 0.5, 0.1),
    p_grid_ls  = c(2.0, 1.5, 1.0, 0.5, 0.1),
    q_grid_ls  = c(2.0, 1.5, 1.0, 0.5, 0.1),
    lambda_grid_ls = c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 1.0,1.3,1.5),
    max_iter = 50,
    tol = 1e-4,
    verbose = TRUE
  )
})

# 각 차원별 summary만 모으기
summary_all_dims <- do.call(rbind, lapply(benchmark_results, `[[`, "summary"))
print(summary_all_dims)

```
